services.value: Provides diagnostic and clinical testing (e.g., bacteriology, molecular/virology, mycobacteriology, mycology, newborn screening, parasitology, rabies, serology) and environmental testing (e.g., air quality monitoring, asbestos/lead testing program, environmental microbiology, industrial hygiene, inorganic/organic chemistry, radiochemistry). Also supports credible threat testing request processes and private well testing.
